scientific_integrity: A direct symbolic proof and an independent finite enumerator are provided. Related known two-run results and unindexed priority risk are disclosed; no independent expert verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only binary circular words containing exactly two marked occurrences; the general odd-length non-equivalent-square conjecture is not resolved. Finite checker verifies cases only, not the infinite theorem.
title: Exact circular Abelian-square type spectrum for two isolated marked letters
